rows.en: Hokushin, chief of Hokushin's Six... I come!
Behold... the power of my Yatenko.
Your fate... ends here.
Your life... I shall take it... Kukuku.
I shall erase you.
At the very least, fall beautifully.
Are you afraid? Terrified!? But it will all end soon.
Your obsession... it too shall return to nothing...!
Unable to let go of a woman who will never return... You fool.
Black Prince... return to the world of darkness.
Gene-crafted white fairy... perish!
A doll, just like Lapis... Heh... Kukukukuku.
Along with that pompous battleship... become dust in space.
All who stand before me... are bound to perish...
It is only natural that the weak perish...
You dare stand in my way... Imbecile.
I have grown bored of you. ...Now fall.
...Splendid. But I have seen your weakness...!
None gather the corpses of the dead... To destroy is my fate...
Ugh...! Is it I who will vanish!?
My heart is already empty...
I shall not fall to your hand... so easily...!
Human obsession... is this...!?
When I die... I take you with me...!
My life... I cast it away long ago...!
Your obsession... I never thought it was this strong...
Heh... Heheh... What do you wish for... what do you desire...
What... a blunder...
I took this lightly... my own blunder.
My Yatenko... will not be destroyed by this.
...A skilled one, I see.
This is how a battle ought to be...
Careless... Next time I will dodge it...
You can keep pace with my Yatenko... Akito Tenkawa?
That obsession... I shall praise it as admirable.
Feeble...
Laughable... You are a small fry after all.
Such a strike... how pathetic.
This is your limit... Kukukukukuku.
You are not worthy to fight...
The weak should leave.
Powerless... Akito Tenkawa.
A strike as weak as your heart...
...Gale!
rows.notes: Literal rendering of a one-word attack shout (shippu); not in glossary.

rows.en: ...Thunder!
rows.notes: Literal rendering of a one-word attack shout (jinrai); not in glossary.

rows.en: Laughable!
rows.notes: Shared with Carl Gainer and another pilot; works as a generic scoff.

rows.en: Careless... Akito Tenkawa.
Foolish... This is all you amount to.
So utterly... powerless.
Did I push too far... A blunder...!
...Keeping your distance... how cowardly.
I see an opening!
Forgetting my presence was your folly...!
Yatenko... strikes again!
Fall back, my limbs. I shall strike...!
This formation... now is the time to strike!
Things never go as one wishes.
Fall back...
Have you forgotten that I am here?
You are no match for that one.
Fall back without breaking formation.
An insolent rabble. ...Annihilate!
Perish into darkness.
Sever!
Perish! Vanish from this world...
You fools, the lot of you... Perish!
Die!
Can you read the movements of my Yatenko...?
Slash!
To fall is your fate... Perish!
With the single word "perish"... let us end this.
Scatter!
Vanish... amid petals of flame.
Here I come!
I'll crush you!
You're mine! Perish...!
All for the new order...!
I'll waste no time. I strike first!
Vanish!
Amateur... Perish!
All who defy us... die!
Now there is only death...!
Take this!
Nadesico... sink!
Vanish, Nadesico...!
War is no game... Don't mock us!
Those fools... grinning like idiots!
Akito Tenkawa... you won't escape me!
We won't let you interfere, Akito Tenkawa...!
Traitor... Perish!
I show no mercy to those who lost their pride!
I'm not beaten yet.
Now I'll strike at you.
I won't let you have your way...!
There is only retaliation.
Don't get cocky... Perish!
I won't just sit here in silence!
There is only the counterattack.
Receive your retribution...!
C-Commander!!
Curses!!
This is the end...!!
Uoooohh!!
rows.notes: Generic scream; shared with Benkei, Ichiya, Kou, Ayato.

rows.en: Ugh! I took them for amateurs...!
rows.notes: Read as self-reproach for underestimating the enemy.

rows.en: Ggh...! On the name of Hokushin's Six, I won't lose!
Damn! My machine won't hold out like this!
I can't afford another blunder!
Nnngh...! Curse them, how dare they!
rows.notes: kyatsu has no gender cue; used 'them'.

rows.en: Th-this won't end like this!
Did I misjudge their strength...!!
A-Akito Tenkawa... Is this his obsession!?
Nngh! That ship must be sunk after all!
Be careful...! They grin like fools, but they're strong!
Hoh... Not bad.
Gruuugh!
Nngh! A blunder!
Don't think that's enough to stop us, Hokushin's Six!
Ugh! They've caught up to me!
Damn it!!
A dangerous one...!
Curses, to be hit by that rabble!
Curse you, Akito Tenkawa...!
Nnngh...! Damn that Nadesico...!
Grr! Did their words throw me off!?
Merely a scratch.
Hm... I couldn't fully dodge it?
Heh... Is that all?
rows.notes: Shared with Guard Captain Mors; generic.

rows.en: The damage is not serious.
A trifle like this...
Heheh... What was that?
Too weak...
Damage is minor...
Heheh... Is that all your obsession amounts to?
Is that all, Nadesico?
Your performance seems worse than in the old days.
Too soft...
I'll just watch from on high...
rows.notes: Idiom for idle spectating; used as a dodge taunt.

rows.en: Laughable...!
All talk...!
Hmmph!
I won't take a direct hit.
That much... I'll simply repel it.
Distortion Field, deploy.
rows.notes: Source uses the kanji term (spatial distortion field); mapped to glossary Distortion Field.

rows.en: Such a thing is meaningless...
Come back when you're ready.
Don't underestimate us!
Did you see? That is our true power...!
I can't even counterattack...!
Grr, a blunder...!
I can't lay a hand on them...!
Careless... From my blind spot...!?
Nngh... at this range...
Where did they run off to...!?
Striking again!
You show an opening? Foolish!
Commander, leave this to me!
Don't overstep yourself!
Leave this to me and fall back!
Commander, please fall back!
Prepare for a full assault... Here we go.
Are you ready...? Now!
I leave rear support to you!
Understood. I'll provide rear support.
This will finish it!
As you command. Commencing attack.
Slash!
I'll cut you apart!
Shyeeeeaah!
An opening!
Go! Reppu!
rows.notes: Reppu (gale) likely a move/weapon name; not in glossary. Romanized; please verify.

rows.en: I'll riddle you with holes!
Careless!
Fall!
Please draw them in as close as you can.
We'll handle this with Nadesico's firepower.
Nadesico, commencing attack.
Omoikane, calculate the distance to the enemy.
Nadesico can make it. So, here we go.
...Something feels dangerous. ...These people...
We'll return fire as we are.
Commencing counterattack. Open the gun ports, please.
Omoikane, the intercept program, please.
Please counterattack right away.
We'll destroy them before we're surrounded.
A chance to return fire. Here we go.
This is it...!? All hands, abandon ship!
Omoikane... I'm sorry. ...All hands, abandon ship!
The field... isn't working...!?
It fully pierced the Distortion Field...!?
No... Nadesico is... sinking...!?
Omoikane, hang in there... just a little longer.
We need a way out of this... It's only a matter of time...
We won't sink yet...! I believe in Nadesico...!
We're getting beaten to a pulp, Captaaain~!
rows.notes: Speaker is Hari (addresses Ruri as Captain).

rows.en: Direct hit on the Phase Transition Engine! Uh-oh, this is bad...
rows.notes: Shared Ruri/Hari set; panicky tone fits Hari.

rows.en: The field's output won't go up any further!
Full power to the auxiliary engines! The main engine's in trouble!
Hari, report the situation.
Phase Transition Engine at 20% capacity!
...This is bad.
Direct hit!? Wh-wh-wh-what do we do, Captaaain!
If we go down, we go down. ...Let's do everything we can.
Ugh... at this rate...
Phase Transition Engine output is dropping!
Omoikane... please protect Nadesico...
Please check the field's output.
We'll fall back while maintaining the field.
Engines, give top priority to stabilizing the field.
That hurt more than I expected...
Omoikane, maintain the field's output.
Ah... Did we push too far forward...?
Omoikane, check the damage report! Right now!
The field's effect is... weak!?
Whoa-whoa! This is bad!
What's going on with the Distortion Field!?
Whoa, it got through the field!?
Hari, stay calm and quiet, and check the output.
The field's effect is... Hari?
I'm checking now!
It looks like we'd better fall back a little.
Hari...?
I-it's not my fault! Captain!
It seems they were holding back their strength.
It seems it wasn't much.
It seems a bit got through the field.
Please hurry and recheck the damage.
It was just a light bump.
Omoikane, recheck the generator output.
Please confirm the damage status.
The field... something got through!?
The damage doesn't seem bad, Captain.
Slight damage near the aft hangar.
Aww~, the hull got scratched!
Damage is no problem.
Continuing operations.
Minor damage. No effect on navigation!
Small things add up, as they say. Please don't get careless.
That shook us a bit.
Well, that's about it, Captain.
It'd be easy if every hit were only like this.
Evasive maneuvers...!
As long as we can predict the course, we're fine.
Anyway, please just dodge.
If only we can predict the impact point in time...!
Looks like we're fine, so I'll dodge it~!
For Nadesico, this much is...!
Omoikane, evasion program.
...Amazing. We dodged an attack with a battleship!?
No waaay!? We dodged it?
Evasive action... successful.
That person... missed on purpose...?
Omoikane, defense program.
I'll leave it to the Distortion Field.
We'll rely on the field to get through this.
Field output stable... no problems.
Distortion Field, maximum output!
Nadesico's field keeps us safe.
No attacks have gotten through the field!
Field... maximum output!
Well done, Hari.
The field will repel it.
...That shakes quite a bit.
Better than a direct hit.
...Hurry and reload the ammo!
What!? Didn't we check the remaining ammo!?
We have no choice but to wait and see here.
We have no weapons that can reach the enemy!
Advance at full speed and fire a full salvo.
We'll give covering fire from here too.
Please follow up with a ship's cannon barrage.
Nadesico, advance! Keep up the covering fire!
Please don't bump into us!
Nadesico attacks too, watching for our allies!
We'll support Hikaru.
Following Ryoko, commencing attack.
We'll support Takasugi's unit.
Advance. We'll support Akito.
Following Akito, commencing attack.
Please follow Izumi.
Leave the rest to us and withdraw.
We'll use Nadesico as a shield. Advance.
Nadesico's field will hold. It's fine.
In a situation like this, we can't run away.
We'll protect our allies! Nadesico, advance!
Use this ship as a shield to secure our allies' retreat route!
I don't wanna push a battleship too hard, but... here goes!
Hikaru, please fall back.
Don't overdo it, Ryoko.
Full speed ahead. In front of Takasugi's unit.
Akito. In a situation like this, we can't run away.
Out of practice, Izumi?
Please commence the attack immediately.
Let our firepower do the talking, please.
Bow toward the enemy.
For now, please just fire away.
Nadesico, firing~!
Missiles, horizontal launch.
Deploying a barrage. Missiles, fire.
Missiles, full salvo.
Prepare to attack.
We're on standby, Captain.
All right, fire.
If you miss, you'll be punished, Hari.
Wh-what!? Th-that's not fair...
Okay, fire.
Gravity Blast, wide-area spread.
Roger! Firing the Gravity Blast~!
We'll sweep them with the Gravity Blast.
...Gravity Blast at the center of the enemy line. At max output, please.
Omoikane, starting data link.
Displaying analysis... We're good to go, Captain!
Gravity Blast, fire.
Old skills never die... like Takarazuka...
rows.notes: Pun on an idiom about old skills swapped with Takarazuka; kept the reference.

rows.en: Heheh... I can see right through you~
Hit or miss, it's fate... beriberi, that's a disease...
Shall I give you your last drink of water?
A serious battle... I'll humbly take my shot.
My aim hasn't gotten rusty.
I can see the Grim Reaper coming for you!
Never thought I'd be fighting you lot again.
A mere assassin... Don't get cocky!
Now, what shall I do with you...
Counterattack, nonstop... if you'll allow me.
I really am... a sinful woman...
I'll be your Grim Reaper...!
...I'll be paying you back for that.
This is it... The End~
Ejecting assault pit! Somebody pick me up!
rows.notes: Assault Pit (Aestivalis cockpit block) not in glossary.

rows.en: Time for my welcome party~
rows.notes: Death joke (being 'come for'); meaning a bit uncertain.

rows.en: A pinch, a pinch, a big ol' pinch.
This damage is... a little... of a rip-off...
Whatever will be, will be...!
Seems the Grim Reaper's coming for me instead...
I'm not down yet! I can still fight!
I haven't gotten my Revenge yet...!
Ugh! They call themselves assassins, all right...!
Rokkon shojo, rokkon shojo~ been a while...
It still moves... In fact, it moves like crazy...
The fight starts here! Or there? Where, then?
You'll never be a Grim Reaper like that...!
Seems I'm rustier than I thought.
So things aren't like they used to be.
Want something to eat? A bite? ...There it is~
rows.notes: Pun unclear (possibly on kuu); translated literally.

rows.en: Assassins, ah, assassins, assassins.
It's been... a long break.
The damage... just enough to get tipsy. ...A wee dram...
rows.notes: Pun on 'just a little' vs scotch; adapted.

rows.en: Sir, touching costs extra.
Seems I've gotten rusty too...
It grazed me!?
My reactions are slow... I'm out of practice.
A coup, with this? Awfully convenient for you!
Just testing the waters...! How detestable!
Aah~, hey, hold on, hold on.
That attack... I'll dodge. Dodge, like the car...
rows.notes: Original is a kawasu/river/sea pun; replaced with an English pun.

rows.en: Those moves... one, two, three... I four-saw it...
No need to even rely on the field.
Knock on wood, knock on wood...
Too bad... The exit's that way~
Mo man taaai~
rows.notes: Cantonese for 'no problem', as in the source.

rows.en: Passing each other by is also life...
You won't hit me. Too bad.
What's wrong, assassin!
This is Mars... so Mars-ter some way out.
Thank heavens, thank heavens... Namu Amida Butsu...
I'm counting on you, Lord Field...
Distortion Field, deploy!
That won't break through my field...!
Too bad, so sad~
Too far to reach... Not bad.
Work, work~
Another day, another heave-ho~
I'll follow you unto death~
Out of the way! I'm going in!
Being out of practice... is really scary.
You called, so here I am, ta-da~
A shield from the side? How odd...
rows.notes: Pun on tate (shield / vertical) vs yoko (side); only partly carried.

rows.en: Fall back! I'll rely on the field here!
Aim carefully...
I'll make you into a pincushion, if you please...!
Bunny gun... that'd be the Rabbit Rifle...
rows.notes: Pun on Rapid Rifle (glossary) -> rabbit; kept.

rows.en: Wandering right into my sights...!
Train tracks? No. ...So, a rail? Non...
rows.notes: Rail Cannon pun; meaning partly lost.

rows.en: If this hits you, you won't get off lightly...!
Ate bad sea bream, got a bellyache... That's a hit~
Field at full power! Talk about winging it!
Distortion Attack! Here I go...!
Captain, please watch me!
Calculating relative distance to the enemy... Shooting it down!
Even I can do it when it counts!
Omoikane, help me out too, okay?
No errors in the intercept system! Commencing intercept!
I'll intercept as soon as I acquire the enemy!
They hit us, so I'm hitting back!
Hurry and escape...!
Here gooooes!
We'll hold the line with Nadesico!
All missile hatches, open! Fiiire!
Anyway, I'll scatter as much as I can!
I'm firing the Gravity Blaaast~!
Phase Transition Engine, OK! Gravity Blast, wide-area spread!
Gravity Blast, here I go!
